subject: mathematics
concept: Reading and interpreting a pie chart with percentages
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a virtual pie chart by dragging percent-sized wedges together
exercise.pictorial: Student reads pictured pie chart wedges and states each as a percent of the whole
exercise.abstract: Student calculates actual quantities from a pie chart given percentages and a total

misconception_flags: assumes all wedges are equal size regardless of labeled percent

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
